text_en: Mister soldier has finally decided to grace us with his presence!
We're pretty busy Dwarves, 'ya know, but bah... this time I'll turn a blind eye. When I see how my projects turn out, I forget all about it.
Leave that, I've already told you the chain's tied down enough.
Get your things, we're going back to Hafin.
It's a bit rough and ready, but you can bet your last gold piece that everything we put together's tougher than a quellick's roots.
This should settle our debt with Balof. You'll be able to travel to the <color=LOC>desert </color>, now. I'll let you get on, we've got a cannon to build.
